name: White beardtongue
desc: White beardtongue (Penstemon albidus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Penstemon albidus, commonly known as white penstemon, white-flower beardtongue, or Red-Line Beardtongue is a very widespread perennial flower of the mixed-grass and shortgrass prairies.
